title: Pinpoint Counterfactuals: Reducing social bias in foundation models via localized counterfactual generation.
reasoning: The paper focuses on localized counterfactual generation to detect and mitigate social bias (specifically gender bias) in vision-language foundation models like CLIP and Stable Diffusion. It does not evaluate religion, spiritual traditions, or broader moral/ethical reasoning frameworks, nor does it specifically address Large Language Models (LLMs).
